newer_changes_search: No separate web search for PMGKAY. Relied on the snapshots: the Cabinet decision covers five years from 1 Jan 2024 (to Dec 2028); the nfsa.gov.in snapshot shows a DFPD allocation order of 05-Jan-2026 for Feb 2026 with issue price Rs 0/kg, consistent with free grains continuing in 2026. The source note records a draft NFS (Amendment) Bill, 2026 that was not enacted as of 2026-10-25; entitlements under s.3(1) are unchanged.
